# Forge X663

> Maintainer-created GSI networking patches and optional boot-warning removal for Infinix Note 11 (X663), with own-image patching guidance.

The repository includes a boot-image networking patch, an optional Little Kernel warning patch, and the saved original boot image. MedoX71T created the supplied patches. The existing maintainer-listed stock-firmware identifier is `X663-H6915ABCDEFGHIO-S-GL-230113V402`, preserved literally. Match the original stock build before using pre-patched images. Hashes identify files; they do not establish signatures or hardware compatibility.

- [Homepage](index.html): device scope, image inspector, upstream resources, selected GSIs, and risk guidance.

## Selected GSIs

These are the maintainer’s three chosen upstream references, not independent device certification.

- [Derpfest Treble](https://github.com/Doze-off/Derpfest_treble)
- [Project Infinity-X](https://github.com/Doze-off/ProjectInfinity-X_gsi)
- [AxionOS](https://github.com/Doze-off/axion_aosp)

## Upstream resources

- [MediaTek BPF patcher](https://github.com/R0rt1z2/mtk-bpf-patcher): kernel binary patching for a MediaTek arraymap regression; output is not assumed to be a repacked flashable boot image.
- [lkpatcher](https://github.com/R0rt1z2/lkpatcher): Little Kernel patch categories and recovery requirements.
- [Platform Tools](https://developer.android.com/tools/releases/platform-tools): official ADB and fastboot tools.
- [Issues](https://github.com/MedoX71T/Infinix-X663-GSI-Fixes/issues): public reports.

Bootloader unlocking erases data. Preserve matching stock images and a recovery path. Carrier features, hotspot, and SELinux behavior depend on the GSI and firmware. No universal support, invented subsystem counts, bundled build system, or guaranteed outcome is claimed.
